artworks.title: Rossetti's House
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1927)
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a street view featuring a grand building with ornate iron gates. The perspective is from eye level facing the building, partially obstructed by trees and the gates. The etching displays delicate line work and subtle shading for texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic with sepia tones. The building has a statue at its top center. The foreground includes detailed iron gates and pathways, leading to the building with climbing plants. The background shows trees framing the scene and the building's intricate facade.

artworks.title: St. Martin's Bridge, Toledo
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1927)
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape with a river running through it. In the foreground, there is a bridge leading to a group of buildings on a rocky incline. Beyond the bridge, there are additional structures, possibly towers, adding to the old-world architecture vibe. The sky has wispy clouds, and the etching has detailed line work capturing textures. The color palette is mainly monochromatic, emphasizing light and shadow contrasts. In the distance, there are hills or mountains.

artworks.title: House Where Whistler Died
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1927)
artworks.description: The image shows a row of buildings and a church in an urban setting. The church tower is prominent among the structures. A large tree is on the right side of the image, with branches framing the top. In the distance, more buildings are visible with intricate architectural details. Some individuals are near a fence lining the street. The image is detailed and appears like an etching, using fine lines. It has a monochromatic color scheme with a vintage look. Light, shadow, and precise lines create a subdued yet intricate scene.

artworks.title: The Cliffs of the Trinity
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on Van Gelder Zonen laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with towering rock formations dominating the scene. The ground is rugged and textured, leading the eye towards the rock pillars in the center. A structure or building is perched atop one of these rocks. The background shows the horizon above the structure, with clouds and sky stretching out beyond. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes adding texture to the rocks. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of charcoal or ink, emphasizing the contrast between the rocks and the sky.

artworks.title: Broadway, Above Twenty-Third Street
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image depicts a city street lined with tall buildings. The perspective is eye-level, emphasizing the grandeur of the architecture. The sketchy pencil strokes convey movement and vibrancy. The monochromatic color palette and shading create depth. People and vehicles populate the foreground, becoming less detailed in the distance. The scene captures urban activity.

artworks.title: William Street
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape with a narrow urban street lined with tall buildings. The perspective leads the eye down the street towards a vanishing point. The buildings are depicted with loose, sketchy brushstrokes in black, gray, and white. Small figures resembling pedestrians are visible, adding scale. The horizon is obstructed by the buildings, and the sky is cloudy with abstract strokes. The color palette is monochromatic, creating a dynamic urban atmosphere.

artworks.title: Anaconda, Montana
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with industrial elements. The horizon features buildings, smokestacks emitting smoke, a mound, and a turbulent sky with dynamic clouds. The art style includes bold brushstrokes and a monochromatic palette of blacks, grays, and white highlights. Additionally, there are distant mountains or hills, diagonal lines suggesting rainfall, and detailed ground texture leading towards the industrial scene.

artworks.title: Studies for "Gassed"
artworks.medium: charcoal with graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist, 1949)
artworks.description: The image shows sketches of three figures of soldiers in different poses. The first figure in the upper left corner is depicted lying on their front with one knee bent. The second figure above center is also lying on their front, with a helmet outlined. The third figure in the bottom left is shown lying on their back, dressed in military gear with a rifle next to them. The sketches are done in sepia tones on a plain background.

artworks.title: Loading Up
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image depicts a harbor scene in an etching style. The view shows a dock with multiple ships, detailed with precise lines. The horizon is low, dividing the water from the sky and dock. The ships have tall masts and detailed rigging. The technique uses overlapping lines for depth and texture. The color scheme is sepia, giving an old-fashioned feel. The water reflects the ships and masts. More structures and vessels can be seen in the distance on the horizon.

artworks.title: Thames Street, Newport
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image displays a street scene with buildings lining a dirt road. The structures are rendered with fine lines, capturing the texture of wooden facades and architectural details. Earthy tones dominate the composition, emphasizing browns and sepia hues. In the foreground, a figure stands under an awning with hanging goods. In the background, people are walking or standing in small groups along the roadside. The scene suggests a historical town setting with older building styles.

artworks.title: Fish-Houses
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with buildings along the water's edge, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is in the middle, where buildings meet the sky, with faint structures in the distance. Intricate lines depict buildings, boats, and water, with a muted sepia color palette. Close by, rocks and boats frame the view, leading to a cluster of industrial buildings with tall masts. The landscape extends into docks and ships, fading into the distant skyline.

artworks.title: Oxford
artworks.medium: etching in brown on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows various buildings with angled roofs, including a castle-like tower on the left side. The scene includes a cityscape in the background with spires and domes. The etching is detailed with fine lines, hatching, and cross-hatching, creating texture. The color scheme is mainly sepia with brown tones for depth and contrast. A curving path with a fence leads the eye into the scene. The architecture suggests a historical city setting.

artworks.title: Tout est perdu! Fors la caisse
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding an umbrella, gesturing dramatically on a dockside. The image depicts a port setting with ships in the background. A sign post marked "ANGLETERRE" (England) is visible. Other figures in 19th-century attire are present in the background. The central figure's exaggerated gesture and facial expression are captured in a caricature style, adding a satirical tone. The drawing is detailed with cross-hatching used for shadows and depth, providing a lively representation of the historic harbor setting.

artworks.title: Gloucester Harbor
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image depicts a waterfront scene from a slightly elevated point, as if viewed from land looking out towards the water. The horizon line is visible, mostly uninterrupted. Sparse vertical lines suggest masts of ships on the horizon. The technique features fine etching lines, giving a linear quality to the scene. The color palette is muted and sepia-toned, creating an antique feel. Closest are structures resembling docks and ships with detailed lines and reflections in the water. In the distance, lines fade, suggesting a continuation of the harbor merging into the sky.

artworks.title: Sleeping Lions
artworks.medium: watercolor on paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two lions in a natural setting. One lion is lying on the ground, while the other is reclined on its back. Surrounding the lions are rocky terrain, sparse vegetation, and pale tree trunks. The lighting is soft, indicating either late in the day or early morning. The colors consist of rich browns, cool grays, and muted greens, creating a harmonious atmosphere.

artworks.title: Ton, ton ... ton taine ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two musicians playing brass instruments on a balcony. The background shows urban rooftops and windows. A sign with the word "VINS" and a leafy wreath hangs above them. The drawing style appears humorous or satirical, with lively expressions on the musicians' faces and figures in neighboring windows appearing curious.

artworks.title: George Washington
artworks.medium: mezzotint in black with chine collé on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a man's profile bust with a focus on his head and upper shoulders. He has a prominent nose and chin, short curly hair, and wears a laurel wreath. The man is depicted with minimal clothing, and the background features an oval frame with leaf carvings set against a dark backdrop.

artworks.title: John Carlyle Herbert
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile, facing right. He has wavy hair, a prominent nose, and a clean-shaven face. He is wearing a high-collared garment with large buttons and a cravat or scarf. The background is a simple circular backdrop. The image has a monochromatic tone.

artworks.title: Cherry Blossoms in Full Bloom Along the Sumida River [Sumida-gawa hana-zakari]
artworks.medium: color woodcut on Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: This print shows a river scene with a green hill on the left. Trees with pink blossoms, light blue banners, and crowds of indistinct people dressed in white, pink, and blue are visible on top of the hill in the distance. Closer to us, different types of boats drift along the blue river with people sitting or standing on them. The people wear robes or tunics in shades of gray, green, red, or blue, and they appear to have skin in shades of white and peach. On the right, more vessels with white sails are seen in the distance as the river extends into the horizon. The sky is mostly white, although around the horizon it is a peachy-orange color. On the right side of the print are vertical lines of characters.

artworks.title: James Campbell
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Fevret de Saint Mémin
artworks.medium: engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man in profile view, focusing on his head and upper body. The man is facing to the right and has wave-like hair tied back with a ribbon or bow at the nape. He has a strong nose and chin, and is dressed in a dark formal jacket with a light-colored cravat. The background is a simple, light-colored surface within a circular frame, with a slight textured pattern.

artworks.title: Joseph Whipple
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with roulette on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image is a side profile of a man's upper body within a circular frame. He has features including an aquiline nose, short, wavy hair tied back in a ponytail, and is wearing a high-collared coat with visible buttons and a white cravat. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Congress Voting Independence
artworks.artist: Edward Savage, after Robert Edge Pine
artworks.medium: stipple engraving and engraving on heavyweight wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1949)
artworks.description: This print shows a group of men in a paneled room. The men are dressed in waistcoats, breeches, stockings, and buckled shoes, and they almost all have white hair that curls around their ears. They all appear to have pale skin. Some are standing and gesturing towards a document on a central table, while others are seated on chairs. The room has dark panels and columns that have been shaded in thin, cross-hatched lines.

artworks.title: Franconia Notch, White Mountains
artworks.artist: Stephen Alonzo Schoff, after George L. Brown
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape of Franconia Notch in the White Mountains. The scene features detailed vegetation in the foreground, leading to towering mountains in the distance. The horizon is high, with mountain peaks dominating the skyline. The artwork utilizes engraving techniques with fine lines for texture. The color palette consists of varying shades of gray. The foreground includes trees, rocks, fields, and buildings. In the background, majestic mountains rise, and the sky has subtle clouds.

artworks.title: Portrait of Mrs. Adams
artworks.artist: Stephen Alonzo Schoff, after William Morris Hunt
artworks.medium: etching and engraving in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image depicts an older woman seated in a chair. She has a calm posture, with her hands resting on her lap and the arm of the chair. Her facial features include a slightly round face with a soft expression, and she has dark hair styled back and partially covered by a lace headpiece. She is wearing a dark, formal dress with intricate lace detailing around the collar and cuffs. The setting appears formal, with the chair upholstered in a detailed pattern. The woman is holding a lacy handkerchief. The background is simple and dark, highlighting the woman as the central figure in the image.
